candidates.title: Announcing AI data preparation capabilities in Amazon SageMaker: Build high-quality datasets for model development workflows
candidates.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI now offers AI data preparation capabilities for building high-quality training and evaluation data. Generate synthetic examples, assess and improve datasets, auto-label at scale, and bring in expert review through Python SDK APIs and an agent skill, all from your own notebook or IDE.

candidates.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
candidates.summary: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.

candidates.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
candidates.summary: OpenAI explains how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment with model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.

candidates.title: Cut generative AI costs: Code for rules, models for judgment
candidates.summary: The biggest cost lever in a generative AI system is whether you call a model at all. Learn how to decide whether each workflow step needs a model, and map each option to AWS: deterministic code, a constrained decision call, or a right-sized model on Amazon Bedrock.

candidates.title: Put Gemini to work for you
candidates.summary: Tasks in Gemini is now free of charge in six countries, with new features starting in the U.S. and deeper Google Workspace integration to get things done on your behalf.
